Name: Maggie DNC Complete
Description: Complete Dancer event profile based on Jasper's public-duty structure and checked against BossMod priorities. Opener stays enabled; Save CD is manual only; Dance Partner, healing and shielding remain manual; holds three feathers and spends one at four; automatic interrupt enabled.

Events.Name: Out-of-Combat Reset
Events.Description: Returns Dancer ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state.

Events.Name: Zone Reset
Events.Description: Dancer defaults are reapplied after changing zones.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset
Events.Description: Dancer defaults are reapplied after a wipe.

Events.Name: Head Graze Cast Stop
Events.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Head Graze when in range.

Events.Name: Damage State Guard
Events.Description: Maintains AutoPartner, dance burst, AoE, fan spending, and general Dancer damage toggles in a ready public-duty state.

Events.Name: Pack Damage Release
Events.Description: Maintains standard Dancer AoE, step, burst, and spender toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Events.Name: Hold 3 Fans - Spend 1 at 4
Events.Description: Directly spends one Fan Dance at four feathers, then naturally returns to holding three. No combat toggle switching.

Conditions.Name: Self HP <= 65%
Conditions.Description: Self HP threshold for earlier Second Wind recovery.

Conditions.Name: Second Wind <= 65%
Conditions.Description: Self HP threshold for earlier Second Wind recovery.

Conditions.Name: Self HP <= 75%
Conditions.Description: Self HP threshold for Curing Waltz emergency use.

Logics.Name: Reset Toggles
Logics.Description: Returns Dancer ACR settings to their normal out-of-combat state, including AutoPartner and standard damage toggles, while keeping ForceAOE untouched.

Logics.Name: Head Graze Interrupt
Logics.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Head Graze when in range.

Logics.Name: DPS Toggle Safety
Logics.Description: Maintains Dancer AutoPartner, steps, flourish/devilment, AoE, fan spending, and utility toggles in combat so imported or held toggle states cannot strand the job in a passive state.

Logics.Name: Multi-Target AoE Release
Logics.Description: Maintains standard Dancer AoE, step, burst, and spender toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Logics.Name: Hold 3 Fans - Spend 1 at 4
Logics.Description: Uses Fan Dance once at four feathers.

Items.Name: Interrupt
Items.Description: Uses Head Graze on interruptible casts in range.
